featured_reviews.name: Sagar Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am sharing my complete experience at the Cashify Thane (Talav Pali) store so that other buyers can make an informed decision before purchasing a refurbished device.

On 26 January 2026, I purchased a refurbished OnePlus 12 from this store and exchanged my iPhone 14 Plus (128GB, approx. 90% battery health, with box and bill) along with an additional payment of ₹5,499. The total transaction value was around ₹35,499. I also had to separately purchase a charger (~₹1,300) and accessories (~₹250).

At the time of sale, I was verbally assured that their high-end flagship devices are properly inspected and non-tampered before resale. Based on that assurance, I proceeded with the purchase.

After using the device, I noticed heating and slight battery drain. I also observed back panel alignment issues. To understand the situation better, I approached an authorised brand service center, where I was verbally informed about possible prior internal issues related to display and water exposure history. No written documentation was provided to me.

Later, when I placed a sell evaluation request through Cashify, the inspection executive who visited my home pointed out visible back panel alignment concerns and dust inside the camera module. He also mentioned that if a device has been opened previously, the waterproof sealing may not remain intact. These observations were shared verbally during the inspection.

Following this, I approached Cashify seeking clarification and requested a refund. I was informed that since it was an offline purchase, refund was not applicable under their policy. A replacement was offered instead.

The process that followed involved multiple emails, escalations, and repeated coordination between customer care and the store. Eventually, I received written confirmation of a valuation of ₹33,050 and details regarding the replacement process. However, the replacement terms were limited — devices were provided in Cashify-branded boxes (not original manufacturer boxes), only a cable was included, and no charger was provided. No written diagnostic report was shared prior to evaluation.

There was a noticeable difference between the proactive engagement at the time of sale and the post-sale resolution process. Store-level coordination required repeated follow-ups, and communication was often redirected between customer care and the store.

Eventually, the replacement process did not conclude, and I chose to resolve the matter independently.

My intention in sharing this review is not to defame but to present my experience transparently. I would strongly recommend that customers purchasing refurbished devices:
- Ask for complete written clarity on inspection and grading
- Confirm accessories included in the package
- Clearly understand offline refund policies
- Request written documentation wherever possible

Refurbished purchases require full transparency, and it is important to ensure all terms are clearly understood before proceeding.

I would recommend that customers purchasing refurbished devices ask for complete written clarity on inspection details, grading, included accessories, and offline refund policies before proceeding.

I am not writing this to defame anyone. I have simply shared my personal experience exactly as it happened so that others can make informed decisions.
